markets.description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between Liquid and Team Falcons in the BLAST Bounty Playoffs, scheduled for January 22 at 10:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Liquid" if Liquid win the match against Team Falcons.

This market will resolve to "Team Falcons" if Team Falcons win the match against Liquid.
